title: LIB-219 · Renew a loan once
description: Flows and components touched by library-api PR #412 (LIB-219), the design it follows and the review, with each comment pinned on the sequence diagram.
headline: Members can renew a loan once, and an unknown loan answers 404
lead_html: Members asked to extend their loans from the app. POST /v2/loans/{loan_id}/renew already existed but renewed without limits. The PR allows one renewal per loan, refuses it while another member holds the book, and answers 404 instead of 500 for an unknown loan.

sections_before_review.title: Design it follows
sections_before_review.html:
Rules in one domain policy

  • The handler loads the loan and asks RenewalPolicy. The policy holds both rules, so the view and the handler stay free of them.
  • A hold by another member wins over the renewal. The policy asks HoldsFinder, which already existed.
  • The handler saves the new due date and the counter, then publishes LoanRenewed.

Contract with the app

CaseBeforeAfter
Renewal allowed200200, with renewals
Already renewed200, renewed again409 · renewal_limit
Book on hold200409 · book_on_hold
Unknown loan500404 · loan_not_found

The member app already shows any 409 message from the API, so no app release is needed.

review.sub_html: Static review of the diff against main, without running the tests. One new finding, and the reviewer's thread is resolved.
checked: The migration adds renewals with default 0, so every existing loan can renew once.
LoanRenewed carries only ids and the new due date, and its consumer already reads due_date.
Both 409 codes are in the OpenAPI schema with an example.
review.outside_diff_html: HoldsFinder counts expired holds as active. The PR does not change it, but it can refuse a renewal that should pass.

findings.title: Two parallel renewals can both pass the once-only check
findings.state_html: Raised in this review. Not posted yet.
findings.what_html: RenewalPolicy reads loan.renewals from the row loaded at step 4, and the handler writes it back later with a plain save(). Nothing locks the row between the read and the write.
findings.impact_html: A member taps Renew twice on a slow connection. Both requests load the loan with renewals = 0, both pass the check and both save. The due date moves 28 days instead of 14, and two LoanRenewed events go out.
findings.fix_html: Load the loan with select_for_update() inside the transaction, or save with a conditional update (WHERE renewals = 0) and answer 409 when no row changes. A test with two concurrent requests would cover it.

findings.title: An unknown loan answered 500
findings.state_html: Raised by Alex Doe. Fixed in c0ffee1, thread resolved.
findings.what_html: LoanRepository.get let DoesNotExist reach the generic error handler.
findings.impact_html: POST /v2/loans/999/renew with an id that does not exist answered 500 and alerted the on-call channel.
findings.fix_html: The repository raises LoanNotFound, and a handler registered on the API maps it to 404 with code loan_not_found.
